primaryMetaphor: Smart Workshop vs Traditional Workshop - contrasting on-demand vs upfront loading through tangible workspace metaphors
visualContinuity: Central dividing line that transforms from mystery barrier to workshop divider to performance comparison axis

scenes.name: The Question Hook

keySync.visualEvent: Split-screen mystery containers materialize with central question text

scenes.visual: Split-screen composition with mysterious glowing containers. Left: sleek geometric Skills container with subtle cyan glow. Right: complex mechanical MCP structure with purple energy. Central vertical divider at 50% with question 'Skills vs MCP?' appearing in elegant white typography. Soft particle effects create intrigue.
scenes.connectsTo: Left container transforms into Skills toolbox

scenes.name: Skills Introduction

keySync.visualEvent: Left container opens to reveal organized modular toolbox structure

scenes.visual: Left container transforms into smart modular toolbox with clean organization. Sleek drawers and compartments visible, emphasizing order and efficiency. Skills label appears with satisfying click animation. Right side remains mysterious. Emphasis on 'just a folder of instructions' with filing metaphor.

scenes.name: Skills Architecture Deep Dive

keySync.visualEvent: Top drawer opens revealing name tag and description, body remains closed

scenes.visual: Detailed exploration of Skills two-part structure. Top drawer (front matter) opens to show name tag and brief description - minimal, lightweight. Body section initially closed. At 'instead' (frame 610), demonstrate on-demand loading: drawer slides open only when needed, showing efficiency. Smooth geometric animations emphasize lazy loading concept.

scenes.name: MCP Server Introduction

keySync.visualEvent: Right container transforms into active server with network connections

scenes.visual: [3D REQUIRED] Right mystery container transforms into sophisticated server architecture. Multiple network nodes with pulsing data connections. Emphasis on 'actual server, not just collection of files' through realistic 3D server visualization. Network topology with flowing data streams. Real-time connection indicators and server status lights.
scenes.buildsFrom: Right mystery container from previous scenes

scenes.name: MCP Loading Overwhelm

keySync.visualEvent: Massive data flood overwhelms context window with performance warnings

scenes.visual: Server demonstrates upfront loading problem. All tools and descriptions flood into visible context window - progress bar rapidly fills to 100%. Visual representation of context overflow with warning indicators. Performance degradation shown through stuttering animations and red warning states. Contrast with Skills' selective loading.

scenes.name: Capabilities Contrast

keySync.visualEvent: Side-by-side demonstration of raw tools vs structured behavior patterns

scenes.visual: Clear side-by-side operational comparison. MCP side shows raw floating tools (Google Drive icons: create, delete, update files) with API capabilities. Skills side displays structured behavior patterns: document templates, best practices guides, writing frameworks. Visual distinction between 'what you can do' vs 'how to do it well' through organized vs scattered layouts.
scenes.connectsTo: Final synthesis and call to action

scenes.name: Conclusion & Call to Action

keySync.visualEvent: Call-to-action overlay appears with engagement prompt

scenes.visual: Final decision framework showing both systems in harmony for different use cases. Clean summary showing MCP for raw capabilities, Skills for structured behavior. Professional call-to-action overlay: 'Comment skills for the link' with elegant typography and subtle animation. Confident, authoritative closing that reinforces the key insight.
scenes.emotion: Confidence and readiness to take action
